rows.grounds: compound; locative of time/occasion indicating end of platform construction
conjunction connecting to prior ritual prescriptions

items.question: At what ritual moment must the sprout offering be performed?
premises: The sprout offering is a prescribed ritual act.
The act is linked to the completion of the platform.
The act is also tied to a previously stated time.
items.inference: The sprout offering must be performed at the previously stated time upon completion of the platform.
uncertainties: The specific previously stated time is not identified within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And at the previously stated time, upon the completion of the platform, the offering of sprouts is to be performed.
